0022600128.text: The Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Celtics (1-1, one game back in the Atlantic) for Brooklyn's fourth game of the season, with Brooklyn 14th in the East and fifth in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and Boston 8th in the East and third in the Atlantic. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, most recently a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026. Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain) and Mikel Brown Jr. (day-to-day, rest, game-time decision), while Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness).
